THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS PROJECT IS TO CONTINUE DEVELOPMENT OF THE EMISSION CONTROL TREATER (ECT), A NEW WELL PAD PROCESSING TECHNOLOGY THAT USES A FUNDAMENTALLY DIFFERENT PROCESS TO ACHIEVE BETTER SEPARATION, REPLACING EXISTING EQUIPMENT WHILE ELIMINATING NEARLY ALL EMISSION SOURCES ON THE PAD. THE TECHNOLOGY REPLACES FIRED HEATER TREATERS THROUGH ELECTRIFICATION OR CONSOLIDATION TO A SINGLE FIRED HEATER WITH EMISSION CONTROLS, ELIMINATES TANK VAPORS THROUGH BETTER CRUDE STABILIZATION, REMOVES OR REDUCES THE NEED FOR INTERNAL COMBUSTION ENGINE DRIVEN COMPRESSION, AND IS A SIMPLER SKID-BASED PREFABRICATED PROCESS WHICH ELIMINATES MOST FUGITIVE EMISSIONS.
